definitions.gloss: frequent occurrence; multiple outbreaks; repeated incidents
definitions.explanation: The occurrence of something many times or in large numbers. Used especially for negative events like accidents, crimes, or disasters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交通|こうつう}{事故|じこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多発|たはつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多発|たはつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Crime is frequent in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ→土砂崩れ：09257_doshakuzure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多発|たはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Landslides occur frequently during typhoon season, so early evacuation is important.

notes:
Describes the frequent or repeated occurrence of events, especially negative ones. Composed of {多|た} (many) + ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (occurrence/outbreak). Commonly used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {多発|たはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{多発|たはつ}: frequent accidents
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{多発|たはつ}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧: accident-prone zone
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多発|たはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: crime occurs frequently
- {多発|たはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: area with frequent occurrences
- ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多発|たはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: food poisoning breaks out frequently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頻発|ひんぱつ}→頻発：14670_hinpatsu⟧: frequent occurrence — very close in meaning, slightly more formal
- ⟦{続出|ぞくしゅつ}→続出：13860_zokushutsu⟧: occurring one after another — emphasizes successive appearance
- ⟦{頻繁|ひんぱん}→頻繁：08631_hinpan⟧: frequently — an adjectival word describing general frequency

USAGE:
Almost always used for undesirable events. You would not typically use {多発|たはつ} for positive occurrences. The compound ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{多発|たはつ}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧ (accident-prone zone) is commonly seen on road signs in Japan.
